The potted_cornflower is inside the gallery building; player must pass through the spruce_fence_gate entrance to reach it
The cyan_concrete_powder is placed inside the gallery room, only reachable by entering through the spruce_fence_gate
The red_glazed_terracotta is inside the gallery building, accessed through the spruce_fence_gate entrance
The light_blue_glazed_terracotta is inside the gallery, only reachable after passing through the fence gate
The powered redstone_lamp is mounted inside the gallery ceiling, visible only after entering through the fence gate
The black_wool blocks are positioned adjacent to the redstone_lamp deeper in the gallery; player navigates past the lamp to reach them
The crafting table and sand supply are at the back of the gallery room, spatially past the black_wool area
Building the 3x3 floor requires sandstone_slabs produced from the crafting step
The cooked_cod chest is adjacent to the floor build zone; completing the floor is the final construction task before the reward

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The diamond_ore is at spawn-relative (-4, 0, 3), approximately 5 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=8 with facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is near and looking at the ore. This is an introductory task so a generous distance is acceptable.

Uses inventory_has because selling a diamond to the armorer villager yields an emerald. Player starts with no emeralds, so having at least 1 confirms a successful trade occurred. Diamond_ore drops a diamond directly when mined with iron pickaxe.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce_fence_gate is at spawn-relative (6, 0, 11), approximately 12.5 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=8 means the player must walk at least ~4.5 blocks toward the gallery to trigger this, confirming intentional approach.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task inside the gallery. The potted_cornflower is at spawn-relative (8, 0, 8). Max_distance=5 ensures the player must physically enter the gallery (interior starts at x=7) since the gallery wall at x=6 blocks direct approach from outside.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task inside the gallery. The cyan_concrete_powder is at spawn-relative (10, 0, 7). Max_distance=5 requires the player to be well inside the gallery to trigger this milestone.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task inside the gallery. The red_glazed_terracotta is at spawn-relative (12, 0, 7). Max_distance=5 requires physical presence inside the gallery near the block.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task inside the gallery. The light_blue_glazed_terracotta is at spawn-relative (14, 0, 7). Max_distance=5 requires the player to be deep inside the gallery to trigger.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The redstone_lamp is ceiling-mounted at spawn-relative (12, 3, 12), powered by redstone_block below. Max_distance=6 with facing_tolerance=60 accounts for the elevated position requiring the player to look upward from inside the gallery.

Uses inventory_has because mining black_wool drops the black_wool item into the player's inventory. Player starts with no black_wool, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. Wool can be mined with any tool or bare hand.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sandstone_slabs results in the item appearing in inventory. The two-step recipe is: 4 sand → 1 sandstone, then 3 sandstone → 6 sandstone_slabs. Min_count=6 confirms one complete slab crafting batch (requiring 12 sand for 3 sandstone). Player has 24+ sand available.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a floor means placing sandstone_slab blocks in the designated area. The build zone has a cobblestone base at (-6,-1,-6) to (-4,-1,-4) with oak fence borders. Box is (-6,-1,-6) to (-4,0,-4) — a tight 3x2x3 volume matching the build zone. Min_count=9 confirms a complete 3x3 floor.

Uses inventory_has because the player must retrieve cooked_cod from the reward chest at (-8, 0, -5). The chest contains 5 cooked_cod. Min_count=1 confirms the player interacted with the chest and took the food. KNOWN LIMITATION: This verifies possession rather than consumption, but is the most reliable available rule type for this task.

scene_description: A compact village scene with two activity branches: (1) A diamond ore block and villager trading post near spawn-left for the diamond trade chain, and (2) A decorated gallery building accessed through a spruce fence gate to spawn-right containing decorative blocks, black wool to mine, and a crafting area. Outside the gallery behind spawn is a marked floor-building zone with a reward chest containing cooked cod. A crafting table is placed outside the gallery near the villager for diamond-related needs.
task_text: Explore this village compound and complete all objectives: Find and mine the diamond ore, then sell a diamond to the armorer villager. Find the spruce fence gate and enter the decorated gallery to locate the potted cornflower, cyan concrete powder, red glazed terracotta, light blue glazed terracotta, and redstone lamp inside. Mine the black wool near the lamp, then use the crafting table and sand at the back of the gallery to craft sandstone slabs. Exit the gallery and build a 3x3 floor with sandstone slabs in the marked area behind spawn. Finally, take and eat cooked cod from the reward chest.

- Gallery building: (6,0,6) to (18,4,18) stone bricks, hollow interior (7,0,7) to (17,3,17)
- Gallery entrance: x=6, z=11-12, two spruce fence gates facing west

- Cyan concrete powder: (10, 0, 7)
- Red glazed terracotta: (12, 0, 7)
- Light blue glazed terracotta: (14, 0, 7)
- Redstone block: (12, 2, 12) — powers lamp above
- Redstone lamp: (12, 3, 12) — ceiling-mounted, lit
- Black wool: (13,0,13), (14,0,13), (13,0,14) — 3 blocks near lamp
- Crafting table (interior): (16, 0, 16)
- Sand blocks: 7 blocks at (15-17, 0, 15-17) area
- Floor build zone: (-6,-1,-6) to (-4,-1,-4) cobblestone base with oak fence border
- Reward chest: (-8, 0, -5) containing 5 cooked cod
- Player given: iron pickaxe, shears, 24 sand
